description: Itemized first-year cost of ownership from HelloBooks’ own published prices. Pass a core `plan` (free/starter/pro/business/scale), optional `country`, `billing` (annual|monthly, default annual), `addOns` (warehouse-addon/manufacturing-addon), and one-time `creditPacks` ([{id, quantity?}]). Returns line items, the plan/add-on annual cost, one-time credit-pack cost, `totalFirstYear`, and `annualBillingSavings` (saving vs paying monthly) in the country currency. An estimate from list prices, not a quote (taxes/discounts excluded) — confirm with list_plans / list_credit_packs.

addOns.description: Stackable per-entity add-on modules to include.

billing.description: Billing cadence (default annual). Annual is cheaper on paid tiers.

country.description: ISO country code for local pricing. Omit for the USD/default list.

creditPacks.description: One-time AI credit packs to include (with optional quantity).

plan.description: Core plan tier to cost out.

name: estimate_annual_cost
